WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s1.avg_pulse) as avg_col2
  FROM step1 s1
  JOIN telescopes t ON s1.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(s2.avg_col2) as overall_avg
  FROM step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT s2.equipstatus, s2.avg_col2, (s2.avg_col2 - s3.overall_avg) as diff
  FROM step2 s2, step3 s3
  WHERE s3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s2.avg_col2 > s3.overall_avg
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT AVG(s4.avg_col2) as avg_from_step4
  FROM step4 s4
),
step6 AS (
  SELECT s4.equipstatus, s4.avg_col2, s4.diff, (s4.avg_col2 - s5.avg_from_step4) as diff2
  FROM step4 s4, step5 s5
  WHERE s5.avg_from_step4 IS NOT NULL AND s4.avg_col2 > s5.avg_from_step4
)
SELECT AVG(s6.avg_col2) as col1, AVG(s6.diff) as col2, AVG(s6.diff2) as col3
FROM step6 s6
